description: This file defines data models and response structures related to compliance and history of boards and blocks within the Mattermost focalboard project, including response types, history record types, and query options.

classes.name: BoardsComplianceResponse
classes.description: Response structure for boards compliance query, including pagination info and results.

classes.name: BoardsComplianceHistoryResponse
classes.description: Response structure for boards compliance history, including pagination info and results.

classes.name: BlocksComplianceHistoryResponse
classes.description: Response structure for blocks history, including pagination info and results.

classes.name: BoardHistory
classes.description: Represents historical data of a board, including IDs, deletion status, and update timestamps.

classes.name: BlockHistory
classes.description: Represents historical data of a block, including IDs, type, deletion status, and update timestamps.

classes.name: QueryBoardsForComplianceOptions
classes.description: Options for querying boards compliance, including team filter and pagination.

classes.name: QueryBoardsComplianceHistoryOptions
classes.description: Options for querying boards compliance history, including modification time filter, deletion inclusion, and pagination.

classes.name: QueryBlocksComplianceHistoryOptions
classes.description: Options for querying blocks compliance history, including filters for modification time, deletion, team, and board, plus pagination.
